LOGIN_PASSWORD: Check the config file at {{configFile}} for the password.
TOTP_SETUP_EXPIRED: Two-factor setup expired. Please log in again.
TOTP_SETUP_INTRO: Two-factor authentication is required but not set up yet. Scan the QR code with 1Password (or any authenticator app), or add the secret manually.
TOTP_SETUP_ENV_NOTE: Running several instances? Set TOTP_SECRET to this value on each of them so a single authenticator entry works everywhere.
TOTP_SETUP_CONFIRM_LABEL: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator to finish:
IP_TEMP_BLOCKED: Too many failed attempts. This address is blocked for {{minutes}} more minute(s).
IP_BANNED: Too many failed attempts. This address is permanently banned. Use the recovery link from the server logs or owner email.
VOICE_INTRO: Your Digital Twin can be driven by voice: open terminals, run commands, hand tasks to Claude Code. Choose your defaults; everything can be changed later in the Voice panel.
VOICE_ENABLE_ON: On (nothing is heard until you start listening)
VOICE_ENABLE_OFF: Off (hide it; can be re-enabled in settings)
VOICE_LISTENING_PTT: Push-to-talk: tap the microphone or press Ctrl+Shift+Space (recommended)
VOICE_LISTENING_WAKE: Wake word: say the phrase below, then your command (microphone stays open while the panel is visible)
VOICE_WAKE_NOTE: Two or more words trigger far less by accident.
VOICE_BRAIN_ACCOUNT: My Claude account – same login as the claude terminal command (no API key)
VOICE_BRAIN_KEY: An Anthropic API key (fastest, billed per use)
VOICE_BRAIN_NOTE: The key is stored encrypted on this server only. If you choose the Claude account, log in by running claude in a terminal once.
VOICE_OPTIONAL: only for the API key option
VOICE_BAD_KEY: Anthropic API keys start with sk-ant-.
VOICE_KEY_REQUIRED: Enter an API key, or choose the Claude account option.
VOICE_PAUSE_NOTHING: A pause is just a pause: the command runs when I say the execute word or tap (recommended)
VOICE_PAUSE_EXECUTE: A long pause runs the command
VOICE_PAUSE_CANCEL: A long pause cancels the command
